name: Geo-11
version_info: Latest stable (0.6.60.22 and earlier). SR Weave support requires v0.6.60.23.
summary: The community successor to Nvidia 3D Vision. A fork of 3DMigoto that injects Dual-View Rendering into DirectX 11 games without requiring Nvidia's deprecated stereo driver. Game-specific fix files correct geometry and depth per title. VR output supported via Katanga (SteamVR) or VRScreenCap (OpenXR). SR Weave (simulated_reality) requires Geo-11 v0.6.60.23.
compatibility_notes: DirectX 11 only. DX9 games require dgVoodoo2 wrapper first. Works on any modern GPU. VR: run via Katanga.cmd for SteamVR with motion controls, or VRScreenCap.cmd for OpenXR with better performance.
